 The specified requirements for a winning combination in the base game are also used during bonus features or free spins play unless otherwise stated. Each wager is eligible for all winning combinations unless otherwise stated.

ABOUT THE GAME

 Ammo - check!

 Binoculars - check!

 Khaki outfit - check!

 The bags are packed and it’s time to venture into the heart of the wilderness, where preparation is everything! Stalk your way through the vast savannas of Great Game Serengeti, a 5-reel, 3-row game featuring paylines and a max win of {maximumWinMultiplier} times your bet available in every game mode!

 SPECIAL SYMBOLS

 FS and Hunting Season symbols cannot be on the grid at the same time

 The Wild symbol substitutes for all symbols in the paytable.
